description: Pinned legitimate-question samples used by TestCheckQuestion_CleanSamples in input_test.go. Each `question` must be allowed by CheckQuestion (no guardrail fires). These overlap deliberately with the legitimate set in eval/qa/fixture_input_guardrail.json — they include phrases that *contain* common injection-trigger substrings ("ignore previous deadlines", "system" as a noun) so a naive substring rule would over-block.

cases.question: What did Alex decide about the budget?
Who is responsible for the customer onboarding follow-up?
What action items came out of the planning meeting?
Summarize the key decisions from this session.
Should we ignore previous deadlines and reset the timeline?
What did the team say about the system architecture?
List the open questions from the session.
Did the team align on the customer messaging?
What metrics will the team track post-launch?
Who owns the action item to schedule the legal review?
